info.title: Kuwaiti Experience Car Rental API
info.description: Car rental search, quote, reservation and booking-fee payment for the mobile app. Inventory is managed in the CMS. The app charges only the booking fee through MyFatoorah; the rental amount is paid to the provider at pickup. Money is a three-decimal KWD string. Responses use the shared envelope; image keys are resolved through meta.images. See rental-api.md for the flow.
